text:
kai: Heads-up team: APAC marketplace listing launch next Thursday. We need a compact launch choreography focused on press embargo timing, localized microsite swap, HW partner tile gating, and SI quickstarts. Who's in for owners?

miranda: I'll take press + blog. Drafts in the newsroom doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace/apac-newsroom. Need two partner quotes and the official boilerplate. Propose we keep press embargo narrow so APAC reporters can pick up same-day.

otavio: I'll own the microsite cutover and tile rendering. Important: one HW partner flagged "co-brand limit" — we must confirm allowed usages for hero vs integrations page. Also need final image pack (SVG+PNG).

lena: I'll handle partner legal signoffs and SI messaging. Quick validation: SI badges cleared for integration listing pages, not hero slots. If HW legal doesn't sign, we'll swap to "Partner coming soon" card.

cd-bot: Build pipeline note: scheduled cutover job id mc-2026-06-03-11 queued. Preflight checks: asset availability, feature-flag toggle, CDN invalidation. Dry-run allowed.

kai: Timing suggestion: embargo lift 07:30 PT => that's 23:30 SGT. Blog 23:40 SGT, microsite swap 23:50 SGT, partner email 00:05 SGT. Does that spacing look safe?

miranda: Slight tweak: give press 20m between lift and blog. Suggest embargo lift 23:15 SGT, blog 23:35 SGT, swap 23:50 SGT. That gives APAC desks a buffer. Also, will add UTMs to press assets: utm_source=partner-catalog&utm_medium=press&utm_campaign=apac_list.

otavio: Sequence sounds fine. I'll ensure Cache-Control is set to no-cache for the swap window and will perform a full CDN purge post-swap. I'll include a 15-minute rollback flag window.

lena: Legal status: HW-C waiting on co-brand consent (asset HW-C-09). Reached out at 08:12 PT. If not approved by EOD APAC, we'll hide their tile. SI-2 and SI-3 quotes received and cleared.

cd-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 6352469200 scheduled. Any cutover must complete before that window.

kai: Great catch, cd-bot. Keep cutover before 6352469200. Final owner list: kai (launch owner), miranda (press/blog/UTMs), otavio (microsite/cutover), lena (legal & SI messaging).

miranda: I'll prep the embargo email list and include a plaintext timeline + delivery channels. Also will create a simple media one-pager with partner bullets.

otavio: Pre-cutover dry-run steps I'll run on staging: 1) verify asset pack loads 2) run feature-flag flip test 3) validate redirects and mobile tile display 4) run smoke (200 + hero visible). Dry-run scheduled 60m before final.

lena: If HW-C still pending, I recommend we keep their slot but show "Coming soon" with a contact CTA. That avoids blocking launch. Also confirmed SI quickstart snippets are ready for embed.

kai: Rollback plan: flip feature flag off + CDN purge fallback redirect to previous canonical. Otavio, can you script a rollback curl and health gating?

otavio: On it. Curl rollback: curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.com/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG" -d '{"flag":"marketplace_apac_live","state":"off"}'
I'll gate with health checks: /health (200), /marketplace (200 & hero id), 5xx < 0.5%.

miranda: Growth asked for token-level cost delta monitoring and UTMs for partner attribution. I'll add UTM list to the press kit and tag Growth for dashboards.

lena: Legal-bot reports HW-C approved at 22:45 SGT. Asset pack uploaded to drive and S3.

cd-bot: Preflight dry-run succeeded on staging. Minor css tweak applied and merged (git.sha=def456). Final cutover job ready.

kai: Thanks. Quick checklist before we go: 1) press kit + UTMs (miranda) 2) microsite assets + CDN plan (otavio) 3) legal approvals (lena) 4) SI quickstarts live (lena) 5) dry-run green (cd-bot). Reply with done when complete.

miranda: Press kit shared, embargo email queued.

otavio: Assets in place, runbook posted to #eng-oncall, ready for final cutover.

lena: Legal done, SI docs merged.

cd-bot: Cutover scheduled and will execute at 23:50 SGT. Monitoring hooks active.

kai: Launch window confirmed. We'll use #launch-room as comms channel during cutover. Good work team, ping if anything changes. :rocket:
